title: Receiving Missed Signal several times
symptom: Recently installed xDrip+ version 14fecb8-2019.01.10 and have had multiple 'signal missed' throughout the day. In the event logs, right before it drops signal, it states: 'Aggressively restarting collector service due to lack of reception: backoff: 120'.
evidence_quote: In the event logs, right before it drops signal, it states : "Aggressively restarting collector service due to lack of reception: backoff: 120"
